subject.title: Session transcript doomloop: crash-restart cycle inflates transcript until gateway OOMs

question: What default recovery policy should OpenClaw apply when an active session transcript is oversized or repeatedly crashes during reload?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but truncate-oldest, quarantine/skip, reset, marker-only suppression, and media dedupe protect availability differently and carry user-data and upgrade tradeoffs.

options.title: Default Pre-Open Quarantine
options.body: Mark oversized or crash-looping transcripts degraded before whole-file repair/open, skip them for gateway startup/run, and surface Doctor recovery.

options.title: Truncate Active Transcripts
options.body: Preserve recent turns while archiving or dropping older rows before context rebuild, accepting a stronger conversation-retention policy change.

options.title: Land Marker Cap Only
options.body: Suppress repeated bootstrap marker growth as a partial mitigation while leaving broader loader and recovery policy work open.

recommendation.title: Default Pre-Open Quarantine
recommendation.body: Mark oversized or crash-looping transcripts degraded before whole-file repair/open, skip them for gateway startup/run, and surface Doctor recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the runtime internalization and current-path snapshot and are the best available owner signal for the cross-cutting recovery/default policy choice.
